==Changes==
{{Subject changes header}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 14 January 2026
|update = New Player Improvements Round 2
|change = Players can no longer train combat beyond level 3 on Tutorial Island by shooting seaborne NPCs.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 22 October 2025
|update = Grid Master Rewards, Poll & New Player Improvements
|change = 
* The "How familiar are you with Old School RuneScape?" question during character creation now has its own UI screen, featuring new progress pips.
* Updated default settings for new players to improve visibility, usability, and accessibility.
* Returning and experienced players receive sensible modern defaults (longer AFK timers and interface settings).
* Tutorial Island is now a trackable miniquest with full Quest Journal integration.
* Tutorial Island now rewards 1 [[quest point]].
* Improved the control guide box to update dynamically, disappear, and reappear contextually.
* NPC dialogue boxes have been rewritten for better clarity and character.
* Added soft yellow highlights to important NPCs, Key tutorial objects, interactable objects, and Side-panel icons.
* Woodcutting actions on Tutorial Island are now twice as fast (4 ticks instead of 8), and Fishing speed increased slightly (1 tick faster for shrimp catching).
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 25 October 2018
|update = Halloween 2018 Event and Tutorial Island Improvements
|change = 
*Chopping wood and lighting a fire now comes before fishing and cooking a shrimp, and the first shrimp is no longer guaranteed to burn. Instead, the first is always successful. After that it can burn if you do more - 50% success at level 1.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1055752157079760896|date=26 October 2018|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/105388|archivedate=9 April 2022|notes=This reference may be outdated}}{{Fact|This is discussed on the talk page. The first one should be always successful only if the player receives an axe & tinderbox and/or chops a log and/or makes a fire. If the player uses another player's fire to cook a shrimp before doing any of that, the shrimp can be burnt with a 50% chance as before; if the shrimp is successfully cooked, the player can skip the woodcutting and firemaking part of the tutorial.}} The furnace at mining tutorial is now left-clickable.
*Tutorials on [[music]], [[emotes]], and prospecting were removed. Learning to run was made optional.
*Some other minor tweaks were made to impact the user interface, dialogue and default settings.
}}

}}
